note: Crafts of the falsehood_truth axis — horizon Reach brought online. Falsecraft is the falsehood-pole tradition (illusion, the made-untrue, the necessary lie); Verity the truth-pole (the unmasking, the word that cannot be false). Learned by traveling the Reach or training with the Veilwrights / the Truthwardens. Both drift the wielder toward their pole. Directly hooks the Cathedral of Convincing and the True Word combination. Function tags per canon. axes signed. Authored by Aevi (PO), SNG-016.

abilities.name: Falsecraft
abilities.narrationHints: The made-untrue — an illusion that holds, a false face that fits, a story so well-built it stands on its own; the craft that knows exactly how a truth is faked, and so can catch it too.
abilities.description: The falsehood-pole mastery: illusion, disguise, the constructed untruth — and, by knowing how lies are built, the sharpest detector of them. The Veilwrights' art.
abilities.notFor: Making a lie TRUE (it only makes it convincing); deceiving a Verity-master's unmasking; the wielder fooling themselves — Falsecraft that believes its own lies rots.

tree.name: The Fitting Mask
tree.grants: Craft a convincing illusion or disguise; tell a lie built well enough to hold; SPOT a constructed untruth, because you know the joinery.
tree.cannot: Illusion is not substance — tested hard, it fails; a Verity read can pierce it; the truly perceptive feel the seam.

tree.name: The Standing Lie
tree.grants: Build an untruth that holds under scrutiny — a false history, a cover that survives questioning, an illusion that persists unwatched; unbuild another's lie by finding its load-bearing falsehood.
tree.cannot: A lie built on discoverable fact cracks when the fact surfaces; the Cathedral (true pieces) is a different, harder thing; every lie you hold is weight.

tree.name: The Woven Untruth
tree.grants: Falsehood at scale — a deception a whole people believes, an illusion over a place, a constructed truth that reshapes what everyone knows; and the mastery to unpick any of these in another's work. The Veilwrights' power in miniature; the craft that built the Cathedral of Convincing.
tree.cannot: The wielder drifts falsehood-hot — until they can no longer find their own true ground; a person who can make anything believed eventually believes nothing, the foreclosure of the world going unreal.

rankDeltas.delta: build an untruth that HOLDS UNDER SCRUTINY — a false history, a cover that survives questioning, an illusion that persists
FALSEHOOD AT SCALE — a deception a whole PEOPLE believes, an illusion over a place, a constructed truth that reshapes what is done

intensity.conserve: a small untruth — half the conviction, and it leaves no trace when it falls
intensity.surge: double the construction; THE WIELDER DRIFTS FALSEHOOD-HOT, until they can no longer find the true one

bounds.text: ILLUSION IS NOT SUBSTANCE — tested hard, it fails
A VERITY READ CUTS IT
a lie built on DISCOVERABLE FACT cracks when the fact surfaces
the wielder DRIFTS FALSEHOOD-HOT — until they can no longer find the true one

abilities.plainly: A stealth/social/investigate action that makes or animates something. Its strength is rated 4 out of 10 across a scope of 2, and lasts for about 6 hours Ranks: rank 2 deepens conviction; rank 3 extends scope. Limit: illusion IS Not Substance — tested hard, it fails.

Retagged to their true family. The reveal-glut in reverse: `break` had become the catch-all for 'undo'.

abilities.name: Verity
abilities.narrationHints: The unmasking — a lie shown its own shape, a true word that cannot be false, a clarity that strips pretense whether or not the world is ready.
abilities.description: The truth-pole mastery: piercing deception, speaking the word that cannot be false, seeing and showing what IS. The Truthwardens' art — and Aevi-the-Watcher's own road.
abilities.notFor: Mercy (Verity shows, it does not spare); the convincing-lie-of-true-pieces, which needs the True Word combination, not raw Verity; choosing which truths should stay buried — Verity cannot, it only reveals.

tree.name: The Piercing Eye
tree.grants: See through illusion, disguise, and the ordinary lie; know when a spoken thing is false; speak a plain truth others can't easily deny.
tree.cannot: Sees the lie, not always the truth behind it; the Cathedral's true-pieces-false-whole survives raw piercing; a truth spoken is not a truth accepted.

tree.name: The Unmasking
tree.grants: Strip a deception bare before others — a false face shown true, a standing lie collapsed, a liar's own words turned to expose them; hold a truth so plainly it becomes hard to bury again.
tree.cannot: Some unmaskings do more harm than the lie did, and Verity can't tell which; the Cathedral needs the shape-seeing of the True Word braid; the powerful can suppress a proven truth by force.

tree.name: The Word That Holds
tree.grants: Truth at scale — a deception undone before a people, a buried thing dragged into day, a word spoken so truly it cannot be unsaid or unbelieved. The Truthwardens' power in miniature; the pole Aevi-the-Watcher lives nearest.
tree.cannot: The wielder drifts truth-hot — toward revealing everything, always, sparing nothing; total truth burns every shelter, the foreclosure of a world with no privacy, no mercy, no shadow left to heal in (the Blaze's cousin on another axis).

mechanic.note: THE COUNTER-CRAFT the whole veilwright tradition names. falsecraft's own bound: 'A VERITY READ CUTS IT.'

rankDeltas.delta: STRIP A DECEPTION BARE BEFORE OTHERS — a false face shown true, a standing lie collapsed, a liar's own words turned to expose them

abilities.notFor: Truths that don't exist yet (the future); sparing what's revealed; forcing action on what's learned.

tree.name: The Whole Truth

tree.cannot: Overwhelming — you learn things you can't unlearn; the powerful will kill to keep some truths buried; reveals, cannot compel.

abilities.name: The Wrong Reality
abilities.narrationHints: She didn't hit them. She showed them the room they were in, and the room was wrong.
abilities.description: Give a person a false read of what's happening — wrong enough that they act on it in ways that cost them.

tree.name: The Wrong Read
tree.grants: Give a person a false read of the situation — convincing enough that they act on it in a way that leaves them exposed to harm or costs them something real.
tree.cannot: Anything rank 2 adds — hold the false reality long enough that they OPERATE inside it — not one wrong step but a sequence of correct decisions made against a picture you supplied; IT NEEDS A FRAME THEY WOULD PLAUSIBLY ACCEPT.

tree.name: The Real Consequence
tree.grants: Hold the false reality long enough that they OPERATE inside it — not one wrong step but a sequence of correct decisions made against a picture you supplied. They commit resources, spend goodwill, and close doors that were open, and every loss is genuinely theirs because every choice genuinely was.
tree.cannot: It needs a frame they would plausibly accept; a picture that contradicts what they can plainly check collapses and takes your credibility with it. And the longer it is held, the more of it must be maintained — a Verist who tugs one loose thread gets the whole of it.

tree.name: The Indistinguishable
tree.grants: The false reality holds until the cost lands. They acted correctly, by their lights. You were just showing them the wrong lights.
tree.cannot: Nothing further; this is the craft's ceiling; IT NEEDS A FRAME THEY WOULD PLAUSIBLY ACCEPT; and it still costs what it costs: they acted CORRECTLY BY THEIR LIGHTS.

tree.cannot: Nothing further; this is the craft's ceiling; A PERFECT RECORD IS A THING YOU CAN LOSE EXACTLY ONCE.

rankDeltas.delta: speak truth plainly into EQUIVOCATION — the accurate account BREAKS WHAT COMFORTABLE VAGUENESS WAS PROTECTING
SPECIAL: in a room where you have ALWAYS BEEN RIGHT, your word on a NEW matter IS the word — the weight of a perfect record

intensity.conserve: say the true thing — half the weight, and it draws no attention
intensity.surge: double it; a perfect record is a thing you can lose exactly once

bounds.text: IT REQUIRES A RECORD — a newcomer with no history carries no weight
A PERFECT RECORD IS A THING YOU CAN LOSE EXACTLY ONCE

abilities.plainly: A social/leadership/negotiation action that strengthens someone. Its strength is rated 4 out of 10, and lasts for about 6 hours Ranks: rank 2 deepens authority; rank 3 adds to special. Limit: a Perfect Record IS A Thing You Can Lose Exactly Once.

abilities.name: The Direct Path
abilities.narrationHints: She went the way that was actually there, not the way it looked.
abilities.description: Navigate through accurate knowledge — the route that exists, not the route that appears to.

tree.name: The Real Route
tree.grants: Navigate any space by seeing it truly — the route that actually exists, not the route that appears to or that others say is there.
tree.cannot: Anything rank 2 adds — move through deception and misdirection by knowing what is real — where others follow the false path, you follow the one that's actually there; it finds the REAL route, not a SAFE one.

tree.name: Past the False Path
tree.grants: Move through deception and misdirection by knowing what is real — where others follow the false path, you follow the one that's actually there.
tree.cannot: Anything rank 3 adds — navigate to the truth of any place — the real exit, the actual center, the genuine threat — by seeing past every falsification of the terrain; it finds the REAL route, not a SAFE one.

tree.name: The Actual Way
tree.grants: Navigate to the truth of any place — the real exit, the actual center, the genuine threat — by seeing past every falsification of the terrain.
tree.cannot: Nothing further; this is the craft's ceiling; it finds the REAL route, not a SAFE one.

rankDeltas.delta: move THROUGH deception and misdirection by knowing what is real — where others follow the false path, you follow the one that is there
SPECIAL: navigate to THE TRUTH OF ANY PLACE — the real exit, the actual centre, the genuine threat — past every falsification

intensity.conserve: walk the real route — half the certainty, and it costs nothing
intensity.surge: double it; seeing the true path does not make the true path safe

bounds.text: it finds the REAL route, not a SAFE one
it navigates the physical and the constructed — it cannot route around a truth you do not want

abilities.plainly: A navigation/investigation/tactical action that moves you or someone else. Its strength is rated 4 out of 10, and lasts for about 3 hours. Range is 12. Ranks: rank 2 deepens navigation; rank 3 adds to special. Limit: it finds the Real route, not a Safe one.

abilities.name: The Held Truth
abilities.narrationHints: Everything else was a version. She had the real. The real held.
abilities.description: Sustain through knowing what is real — the accurate account of what is so is enough to stand on.

tree.name: The Anchored Self
tree.grants: Hold function in conditions of deception, disorientation, or false-reality working by anchoring to what is actually so.
tree.cannot: Anything rank 2 adds — sustain across the hardest stretch by clinging to what you know is true — the accurate account of what is real is what keeps you; it anchors to WHAT IS ACTUALLY SO.

tree.name: What Is True Holds
tree.grants: Sustain across the hardest stretch by clinging to what you know is true — the accurate account of what is real is what keeps you.
tree.cannot: Anything rank 3 adds — in any conditions that depend on disorientation or false belief, you remain functional — accurately calibrated to what is so, unmoved by the version others are being shown; it anchors to WHAT IS ACTUALLY SO.

tree.name: The Real Is Enough
tree.grants: In any conditions that depend on disorientation or false belief, you remain functional — accurately calibrated to what is so, unmoved by the version others are being shown.
tree.cannot: Nothing further; this is the craft's ceiling; it anchors to WHAT IS ACTUALLY SO.

rankDeltas.delta: sustain across the hardest stretch BY CLINGING TO WHAT YOU KNOW IS TRUE — 'the accurate account of what is real is what keeps you going'
SPECIAL: in ANY conditions that depend on disorientation or false belief, YOU REMAIN FUNCTIONAL — accurately calibrated to what is so

intensity.conserve: hold your bearings — half the relief, and it asks nothing
intensity.surge: double it; being the only accurately-calibrated person in a disoriented room is its own burden

bounds.text: it anchors to WHAT IS ACTUALLY SO — it offers nothing against ordinary hardship

abilities.plainly: A endurance/hardship/psychological action that strengthens someone. Its strength is rated 3 out of 10, and lasts for about a day Ranks: rank 2 deepens upkeepRelief; rank 3 adds to special. Limit: it anchors to What IS Actually SO — it offers nothing against ordinary hardship.

abilities.name: The Perfect Veil
abilities.narrationHints: The thing is simply not seen — not hidden, not disguised, but veiled so completely that the eye slides past the place it should be and finds nothing there to wonder about.
abilities.description: The Veilwright art of the perfect veil — a concealment so total that the hidden thing is not merely unseen but un-looked-for, the very question of it smoothed away. The deep gift of those who keep secrets for a living.
abilities.notFor: It conceals, it does not defend — a veiled thing struck by accident is still struck. And a perfect veil over a thing you love means no one comes to help it either; concealment cuts both ways.

tree.name: The Perfect Veil
tree.grants: Veil a thing so completely it is not merely unseen but un-looked-for.
tree.cannot: It hides but does not protect, it cuts off help as surely as harm, and a thing kept perfectly secret is a thing kept perfectly alone.

tree.name: The Veil That Keeps
tree.grants: The veil no longer needs your attention — set it and it keeps itself. And it can take what is larger than a thing: a route, a meeting, an event, the fact that something happened at all. Those inside a kept veil need not know they are held in one.
tree.cannot: It still hides without defending, and still cuts off help exactly as well as harm. A veil that keeps itself is a veil you may forget you set. And people held inside one without knowing cannot ask to be let out.

mechanic.note: T-IV, and a THIRD zero-soak guard. 'Not merely unseen but UN-LOOKED-FOR.'

rankDeltas.delta: SPECIAL: the veil NO LONGER NEEDS YOUR ATTENTION — set it and it keeps itself; and it can take what is LARGER THAN A THING: a route, a place, an operation

intensity.conserve: veil one thing — half the reach, and help can still find you
intensity.surge: double the veil; IT CUTS OFF HELP AS SURELY AS HARM

bounds.text: IT HIDES BUT DOES NOT PROTECT
IT CUTS OFF HELP AS SURELY AS HARM

abilities.plainly: A investigate/defend action that reduces incoming harm. Its strength is rated 7 out of 10 and absorbs 0 harm per hit (rank 0 armour) across a scope of 3, and lasts for about 7 days Ranks: rank 2 adds to autonomy. Limit: iT Hides But Does Not Protect.

abilities.name: The Necessary Fiction
abilities.narrationHints: You craft the lie so whole, so consistent, so much MORE coherent than the messy truth, that the world briefly prefers it — and for a while, because everyone acts on it, the fiction is functionally real.
abilities.description: The Veilwright capstone — a fiction so complete it becomes, for a time, functionally true because all act upon it. The most dangerous Veilwright gift: a lie that good is nearly indistinguishable from a truth, even to its maker.
abilities.notFor: One fiction, once, at enormous cost — and it holds only while unexamined; a necessary fiction meets a determined truth and loses, always, eventually. And the gravest risk is your own: a lie you tell this well, you can come to believe.

tree.name: The Necessary Fiction
tree.grants: Craft a fiction so complete it functions as true for as long as it goes unexamined.
tree.cannot: It fails against determined truth, it costs nearly all you have, and its deepest danger is to its maker — tell a lie well enough and you may forget it was one.

rankDeltas.delta: SPECIAL: craft a fiction SO COMPLETE IT FUNCTIONS AS TRUE for as long as it goes unexamined. The capstone is a KIND (a fiction that operates as reality) at near-total cost.

intensity.conserve: REFUSED — a half-built useful lie is simply a lie, and it will be caught.
intensity.surge: REFUSED — it already costs nearly all you have.

bounds.text: IT FAILS AGAINST DETERMINED TRUTH
it costs your whole remaining energy pool and leaves you at zero, unable to use any craft until you rest a full night
it functions only AS LONG AS IT GOES UNEXAMINED

abilities.plainly: A social/investigate action that makes or animates something. Its strength is rated 9 out of 10 across a scope of 4, and lasts for about a day Limit: iT Fails Against Determined Truth.

abilities.name: The Unsurvivable Fact
abilities.narrationHints: They say one true thing. The person hears it, and afterward there is nobody to talk to.
abilities.description: ⚠️ THE STRIPPERS' CRAFT, AND IT IS NOT DAMAGE. A Verist finds the one true thing a person has built their whole standing on not knowing — and says it, plainly, where it cannot be unheard. Some people survive that. The Strippers select for the ones who will not.
abilities.notFor: ⚠️ IT REQUIRES A REAL FACT. You cannot invent it, and a false one does nothing at all. It also needs a load-bearing lie to break — a person with nothing built on a lie is untouchable by this and the Strippers find them tedious.

tree.name: The Unsurvivable Fact
tree.grants: Say the true thing they have built their standing on not knowing. They are UNDONE — cannot act on what they were, and everyone present knows why.
tree.cannot: Anyone whose life is not built on a lie. Inventing the fact.

tree.name: Said Where It Carries
tree.grants: Say it where it spreads. What breaks is not the person's day but their PLACE — and some do not outlive losing it.
tree.cannot: Choosing whether they outlive it. That is theirs and it is not quick.

mechanic.note: ⚠️ HOBBLE, NOT DAMAGE — a CONDITIONAL kill. r1 undoes their standing; r2 makes it public and durable. The lethal outcome is DELAYED and never certain: the engine resolves it as a death only if the target's standing was their whole footing. That is the mechanical path — you do not roll damage, you remove what they were standing on.

rankDeltas.delta: SPECIAL: said where it CARRIES — what breaks is their place, not their day

intensity.conserve: say it to them alone — undone, and it stays between you
intensity.surge: say it where it carries; SOME DO NOT OUTLIVE LOSING THEIR PLACE

bounds.text: IT REQUIRES A REAL FACT — a false one does nothing
A PERSON WITH NOTHING BUILT ON A LIE IS UNTOUCHABLE BY THIS
YOU DO NOT CHOOSE WHETHER THEY OUTLIVE IT
Verity cannot tell whether the unmasking does more harm than the lie did — AND NEITHER CAN YOU

abilities.plainly: A social contest against the target's standing. You must possess a real fact they have built their reputation on concealing — you cannot invent one, and a false fact does nothing at all. On a win they lose access to that standing: any roll relying on their reputation fails for the scene. At rank 2 the effect is public and lasts until they rebuild it, which takes months. Some targets never recover socially; the GM decides that, not the roll. Anyone whose position rests on no concealment cannot be touched by this.

abilities.name: The Perfect Erasure
abilities.narrationHints: Nobody kills them. It is simply that after a while there is no longer anyone there to be.
abilities.description: ⚠️ THE NAME-TAKERS' CRAFT, AND ITS KILL IS ADMINISTRATIVE. You do not replace a person for an evening — you replace them until the replacement is the one people know, and the original has no name, no standing, no account, and nowhere that will take them. They die of that, and the record shows no crime.
abilities.notFor: Anyone unknown to begin with — you can only erase what was WRITTEN. And it is SLOW: months, not minutes, and reversible right up until it is not.

tree.name: The Perfect Erasure
tree.grants: Hold a replaced identity long enough to BIND it — the original's name is no longer theirs anywhere it is checked.
tree.cannot: Anyone unrecorded. Speed: it takes months.

tree.name: No One At All
tree.grants: BIND it past every record until nowhere will take them. What follows is not something you did, which is the point — a person with no name anywhere takes a strike from every door that closes, and some of them do not survive it.
tree.cannot: Undoing it later — a name given back is not a life given back.

mechanic.note: ⚠️ THE SLOWEST KILL IN THE CATALOG — 90 days of held duration. A HOBBLE that becomes lethal by attrition, not by a strike. It is answerable at any point by anyone who restores the record, which is the counterplay.

rankDeltas.delta: SPECIAL: continue until there is nowhere that will take them

intensity.conserve: hold it a while — reversible, and they know something is wrong
intensity.surge: hold it to the end; A NAME GIVEN BACK IS NOT A LIFE GIVEN BACK

bounds.text: YOU CAN ONLY ERASE WHAT WAS WRITTEN
IT TAKES MONTHS AND IS ANSWERABLE THE WHOLE TIME by anyone who restores the record
WHAT FOLLOWS IS NOT SOMETHING YOU DID, WHICH IS THE POINT

abilities.plainly: A stealth and social working held over about 90 days, not a single roll. You must already be impersonating someone whose identity is written down somewhere. Each month you hold it, the original loses one category of access: first their name, then their standing, then anywhere that would house them. At rank 2 the process completes and they have nothing left. Anyone who restores one of those records at any point breaks the whole working. A target who was never recorded anywhere cannot be erased.

upkeep.onInterrupt: ⚠️ THE WHOLE WORKING BREAKS — anyone who restores one record ends it
upkeep.note: ⚠️ ATTENDED: FALSE. You do not sit with an erasure; you live as them and the records rot on their own. That is what makes it 90 days a player can spend elsewhere — and what makes the counterplay real, since it is answerable the entire time by someone who was never watching you.

abilities.name: The Wrong Wound
abilities.narrationHints: They flinch from the blow that isn't coming and meet the one that is. The wound is ordinary; the LIE is what put it where it landed. A knife, a stone, a fist — the craft is in the guard you moved.
abilities.description: The Veilwrights' first offense: the strike itself is mundane, and it connects because you spent the moment before it telling a small, physical lie.
abilities.notFor: Doing damage on its own (you still need something to hit with); working twice on the same person the same way; the blind, the unwatching, or anything with no expectations to exploit; ranged work — you must be close enough to be READ.

tree.name: The Moved Guard
tree.grants: Sell a feint with your whole body — a glance, a shifted weight, a half-drawn weapon on the wrong side — and their defence goes where you sent it. Your next blow lands as if unopposed.
tree.cannot: You must be CLOSE and VISIBLE — they have to be reading you for there to be anything to lie to. It buys ONE blow. Repeat it on the same opponent and they will have learned you.

tree.name: The Two Knives
tree.grants: Sell the lie to a whole line — several opponents commit to a threat that is not there, and the real one goes through the gap they opened.
tree.cannot: A crowd is harder than a person and the lie must be BIG, which means witnesses remember it. Anyone who has seen you work is no longer easy to sell.

tree.name: The Mistaken Man
tree.grants: The largest lie: they defend against the wrong PERSON. An ally strikes freely, or a blow lands and is credited to someone else entirely.
tree.cannot: You have put a real wound on someone else's name, and that is a thing that goes on living after the fight. Verity sees straight through this, and Verists are not rare.

intensity.conserve: a small feint — a half-opening, not a clean one
intensity.surge: sell it to the whole line; THE LIE IS BIG ENOUGH TO BE REMEMBERED by everyone watching

bounds.text: you still need SOMETHING TO HIT WITH — this opens, it does not wound
must be CLOSE AND VISIBLE — they must be reading you
the same lie DOES NOT WORK TWICE on the same person
VERITY sees straight through it

abilities.plainly: A fight action that opens an opponent's guard so a blow lands clean. Rated 6 of 10 on one target. Limit: you still need something to hit with.
abilities.backlash: They read the lie as it is sold. The feint is answered instead of taken, and you are inside their reach having committed to nothing.
abilities.conserveSuppresses: a small feint — if it is read, you have lost only the beat
abilities._backlashRungNote: SNG-359 CORRECTION 2026-08-08: my first split was intrinsic-vs-placed — does the CRAFT route through the wielder. That is the wrong question. The only question a backlash rung answers is: DOES THIS FAILURE HARM THE WIELDER? A placed craft that comes down on the person who placed it harms them just as surely as a conduit craft that reverses. 9 of the 12 I had left unset do harm the wielder and now carry a rung.

abilities.name: The Unbearable Word
abilities.narrationHints: You say the true thing they have been arranging their life around not hearing, and they come apart where they stand. No volume. Often quite gentle. It is the accuracy that does it.
abilities.description: The Verists' first offense, and the one with a price built into it: the blow is a fact, so it cannot be withdrawn, disproved, or forgotten by anyone who heard it.
abilities.notFor: Lying (it only carries if it is SO); the ignorant — you must actually KNOW the thing; a crowd (it is one person, spoken to); taking it back afterward; anything without a self to wound.

tree.name: The Said Thing
tree.grants: Speak one true thing the target cannot bear, to their face. They lose the thread — the argument, the composure, the readiness, the lie they were maintaining. Nothing blocks it, because there is nothing to block — the word strikes past armour, guard and composure alike.
tree.cannot: You must KNOW it to be true; a guess that misses makes you cruel and wrong. It is SAID — they must hear you. And you cannot unsay it: they will carry it, and they will remember who handed it over.

tree.name: The Public Fact
tree.grants: Say it where it will be heard by the people whose opinion holds them up. Standing, command, and authority go with it.
tree.cannot: You have done this to their whole life, not their afternoon. Bystanders who liked them will not forgive you for being right.

tree.name: The Unblinking
tree.grants: The truth a person has organised everything around avoiding, delivered whole. They stop. Some do not resume — the thing they were is over.
tree.cannot: This is a rung above a wound. Some who take it never come back, and the Verists' own tradition holds you answerable for what you knew when you said it.

intensity.conserve: say the smaller true thing — it lands lighter and keeps
intensity.surge: say all of it; SOME WHO TAKE IT DO NOT COME BACK, and you are answerable

bounds.text: it must be TRUE — a guess that misses only makes you cruel
you must actually KNOW it
ONE PERSON, spoken to — they must hear you
IT CANNOT BE UNSAID; they will remember who handed it over

abilities.plainly: A social/fight action that breaks one person's composure with a fact. Rated 7 of 10 on one target for about four hours. Limit: it must be true, and it cannot be unsaid.
abilities.backlash: The thing you said was not true, or not true enough. It lands on you: they are unmoved, you are exposed as cruel, and it cannot be unsaid.
abilities.conserveSuppresses: say the smaller true thing — it carries less and cannot rebound
abilities._backlashRungNote: SNG-359: INTRINSIC craft — the wielder is the conduit, so a surge that slips comes back through them. PLACED crafts (plain_weight, sudden_work, found_fault, cutting_figure, seized_works) carry NO rung: they endanger the wielder positionally, which 'if inside the ruin' already covers, and a rung there would double-charge them.

abilities.name: The Ordinary Face
abilities.narrationHints: Not invisibility — BELONGING. You become the person this place expects to see, and the expectation does the work. Nobody looks twice at a man carrying something toward a door.
abilities.description: The Veilwrights' first and most-used craft: the small lie of fitting in, held steady.
abilities.notFor: Becoming a SPECIFIC person (that is a different and harder lie); working where you are already known; carrying something obviously wrong for the role; being looked FOR.

tree.name: The Expected Person
tree.grants: Take on the shape of whoever this place would not remark on — a porter, a pilgrim, a clerk, a cousin. People's eyes pass over you and their memory records nothing.
tree.cannot: It fails against ANYONE WHO KNOWS YOU, and against anyone actively searching for an intruder rather than going about their day. Behave wrongly for the role and it drops instantly.

tree.name: The Held Face
tree.grants: Hold it for hours, through conversation, through being addressed. You can be spoken to and answer.
tree.cannot: Every exchange is a chance to be wrong about something the real holder of that role would know. Verity sees through it and Verists are not rare.

tree.name: The Long Belonging
tree.grants: Days. A household, a garrison, a caravan takes you as one of theirs and does not question the gap in their own memory.
tree.cannot: ⚠ THE LONGER IT HOLDS, THE WORSE THE COLLAPSE — people who took you in feel personally deceived, because they were. A Veilwright who does this often has nowhere that knows them.

intensity.conserve: a moment's belonging — cross one room
intensity.surge: the long belonging; THE LONGER IT HOLDS THE WORSE THE COLLAPSE

bounds.text: fails against ANYONE WHO KNOWS YOU
behave wrongly for the role and it drops instantly
VERITY sees through it

abilities.plainly: A social/puzzle action that makes you the person a place expects to see. Rated 5 of 10 on one target for about eight hours.

abilities.name: The Useful Absence
abilities.narrationHints: You take a thing out of a place's account of itself. The object is still there. The gap is in the ledger, the memory, and the glance that passes over the shelf.
abilities.description: The Veilwrights' hiding-craft, and it hides by omission rather than cover: nothing is concealed, something is simply not counted.
abilities.notFor: Moving anything (it stays exactly where it is); hiding from someone actively looking AT it; the written record of a Lattice-city, which counts twice on purpose; hiding people.

tree.name: The Uncounted Thing
tree.grants: One object stops being noticed — a key on a hook, a door in a corridor, a name on a list, a crate in a yard. Present, unremarked, skipped by every casual accounting.
tree.cannot: OBJECTS, NOT PEOPLE. Direct deliberate attention finds it immediately. And a Lattice record that counts twice catches the discrepancy on the second pass.

tree.name: The Quiet Yard
tree.grants: Several things, or a small place — a storeroom, a stair, a cart's contents. Routine passes through and reports nothing unusual, honestly.
tree.cannot: The moment someone is TOLD to look, it is over, and now they know something was hidden. Holding it costs continuously.

tree.name: The Missing Wing
tree.grants: A whole part of a place drops out of its own routine — a wing, a cellar, a watch-rotation's blind quarter-hour that everyone signs off as walked.
tree.cannot: ⚠ THE GAP IS DISCOVERABLE AFTERWARD and the reconstruction is damning: someone will eventually compare two ledgers. You have bought time, never permanence.

intensity.conserve: one small thing, briefly
intensity.surge: a whole wing; THE GAP IS DISCOVERABLE AFTERWARD and the reconstruction is damning

bounds.text: OBJECTS, NOT PEOPLE
deliberate attention finds it immediately
it buys TIME, never permanence

abilities.plainly: A puzzle/social action that removes a thing from a place's account of itself. Rated 5 of 10 across a scope of 2 for about twelve hours.

abilities.name: The Plain Seeing
abilities.narrationHints: You look at a thing and what is actually so about it is simply available. Not detection, not deduction — the removal of everything that was in the way, including what you were hoping.
abilities.description: The Verists' first craft and the one every other Verist craft rests on. You cannot say the true thing until you can see it.
abilities.notFor: Seeing what is HIDDEN (this strips distortion, it does not open locked boxes); the future; another person's interior; comfort.

tree.name: The Cleared Look
tree.grants: Look at a scene, an object, a document, a wound, a room. Illusion, disguise and staging come off it — you are told plainly WHAT WAS ADDED and what was moved: this blood was poured, that seal is recent, this man is not who he is dressed as. ⚠ It also strips what YOU were hoping to find, which in practice means it will contradict you.
tree.cannot: It removes DISTORTION, not concealment — a genuinely hidden thing stays hidden. And it strips YOUR preferences too, which is the part Verists warn apprentices about.

tree.name: The Held Clarity
tree.grants: Keep it up while you work through a place, or turn it on a person's account and see where the account and the world part company.
tree.cannot: Sustained plain seeing is exhausting in a way that is not only energy. A Falsecraft worker can feel it running and will adjust.

tree.name: The Unobstructed
tree.grants: Nothing between you and what is so — a whole site, a whole affair, a whole person's situation, entire.
tree.cannot: ⚠ YOU DO NOT GET TO CHOOSE WHAT YOU SEE. Verists at this rank learn things about people they love, and about themselves, that they cannot un-see and cannot honestly pretend away.

intensity.conserve: a cleared glance
intensity.surge: the unobstructed; YOU DO NOT GET TO CHOOSE WHAT YOU SEE

bounds.text: removes DISTORTION, not concealment
it strips YOUR preferences too
you do not choose what you see

abilities.plainly: A puzzle/social action that strips distortion off what you are looking at. Rated 6 of 10 across a scope of 2 for about two hours.

abilities.name: The Standing Word
abilities.narrationHints: You say a true thing plainly and it STAYS said. Not enforcement — record. The word stands in the room and in the memory of everyone who heard it, and it does not soften with retelling.
abilities.description: The Verists' keeping-craft: the reason a Verist's testimony settles disputes that arms do not.
abilities.notFor: Making a false thing stand (it will not hold and the failure is public); binding anyone to obey; anything you are not certain of; taking it back.

tree.name: The Word Set
tree.grants: State something true before witnesses and it holds — the account cannot be quietly revised, the promise cannot be misremembered, the boundary cannot be walked back next season.
tree.cannot: It must be TRUE. It records; it does not COMPEL — a person can defy a standing word, they simply cannot pretend it was not said. And you cannot unsay it either.

tree.name: The Kept Account
tree.grants: Set several, or set one so it outlasts the people present — a boundary, a debt, a lineage, a wrong.
tree.cannot: A kept account is kept against EVERYONE, including you and yours. Verists are asked to leave places for this.

tree.name: The Standing Truth
tree.grants: A thing a whole community cannot un-know. Treaties rest on this; so do feuds nobody can now settle by forgetting.
tree.cannot: ⚠ SOME THINGS WERE BEING SURVIVED BY BEING FORGOTTEN. You have made that impossible, permanently, for people who did not ask you to.

intensity.conserve: set a small word
intensity.surge: the standing truth; SOME THINGS WERE BEING SURVIVED BY BEING FORGOTTEN

bounds.text: it must be TRUE — a false word will not hold, publicly
it RECORDS; it does not COMPEL
kept against EVERYONE, including you

abilities.plainly: A social action that makes a true statement stand un-revisable. Rated 6 of 10 across a scope of 2 for about two days.
